location_exception_reason: Telephone distribution boxes are standardised B2B telecom infrastructure components; buyer decisions are driven by technical specs (pair capacity, IP rating, material, Krone compatibility), not geographic origin. Location names in titles add no product intelligence.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words ('Manufacturer', 'Supplier', 'Distributor') are redundant in titles; IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this information independently. Removing these words leaves the product meaning intact (e.g., 'Krone DP Box 100 Pair' is complete without 'Supplier').
